subject: Retention retrospective sampling RFI - Brightline SOC2
messages:
From: sara@brightlinebank.com
To: neha.kapoor@redwood.com
Date: 2026-05-03T09:14:00-07:00
Subject: Retention retrospective sampling RFI — Brightline SOC2

Hi Neha,

As part of our upcoming SOC 2 Type II audit (period ending 2026-04-30), our auditors have asked for evidence of past deletion activity and proof that retention/TTL controls executed as configured. Specifically they want a retrospective sampling of deletion operations across our data geozones for the audit period.

Can you provide:
- A proposed sampling methodology (how you pick tenants/objects)
- Links to deletion job logs and any manifest files used to reconcile deleted objects
- Crypto-hash proof or checksum manifests that tie a deletion run to an archival snapshot (where applicable)
- Mapping to residency/geozone for each sampled item

We understand PII redaction is necessary. Please indicate what samples you can provide and an ETA. If there's a preferred packaging format (CSV manifest + tar + checksums), let us know.

Thanks,
Sara L.
Brightline Bank — Audit Team

---

Note: cc'd audit-team@brightlinebank.com for visibility

From: neha.kapoor@redwood.com
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com, rishi_malhotra@redwood.com, mina_haddad@redwood.com
Cc: sara@brightlinebank.com
Date: 2026-05-03T10:02:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Retention retrospective sampling RFI — Brightline SOC2

Team — forwarding Brightline's auditor ask. Quick responses and owners below, please.

Ask summary: retrospective sampling + proof artifacts for deletion activities during audit period. Auditor wants manifests, job logs, checksums, and residency mapping. Must be redacted for PII.

Proposed ownership:
- Rishi: extraction of deletion job logs, manifest generation, hashes
- Mina: evidence packaging, chain-of-custody/attestation statements, redaction guidance
- Marissa: coordinate delivery and any commercial packaging (HubSpot reference) + external comms

Immediate questions I have for you all:
1) Can we produce a 1% tenant-level sample across active regions (us/eu/apac) with logs and manifests? If not, suggest alternatives.
2) Which Job IDs / cron-scheduler names should we include so auditors can trace runs (and approximate volume)?
3) ETA to assemble artifacts in our shared Drive (we should not send raw S3 bucket links publicly)

Please reply inline with short bullets and any blockers. I want a draft package by EOD Friday (2026-05-07).

-Neha
Director, Compliance Programs
Redwood Inference

From: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
To: neha.kapoor@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com, mina_haddad@redwood.com
Cc: sara@brightlinebank.com
Date: 2026-05-04T08:46:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Retention retrospective sampling RFI — Brightline SOC2

Notes from infra side (draft):

Sampling approach (technical):
- We can do a stratified tenant-level sample: 1% of tenant IDs active in the audit window, with at least 2 tenants sampled per region to ensure geozone coverage. If 1% yields <2 tenants in a region, bump to min(2, total-tenants).
- For each tenant selected, we will provide: manifest.csv (object_id, storage_path, sha256, last_modified, deletion_job_id, deletion_timestamp), deletion_job_log.txt (scheduler trace + job stdout/stderr), and a small tar of the pre-deletion snapshot where available (redacted).

Artifacts and sources:
- Deletion job IDs: names follow pattern ttl-purge-<region>-<date>-<runid>, stored in orchestration logs (K8s job annotations + job-run table).
- Object lifecycle: S3 lifecycle rules + partition TTL clean-up via batch purge service (job-run ids map to entries in deletion_jobs table).
- Proof: we can produce SHA256 manifests generated at pre-deletion snapshot time (we keep a short-lived snapshot for recovery). Where snapshots aren't available we will provide ledger entries with the deletion transaction id and CloudTrail entries indicating the operation.

Redaction approach:
- Replace tenant_id with pseudonymized ID and redact any email/PII fields. Keep object_id hashed (sha256) so auditors can validate consistency without seeing raw contents.

Estimated sizes & ETA:
- Each sampled tenant package ~ 1–30 MB depending on object counts; most will be <5MB because we only include manifests + logs + tiny redacted snapshot.
- ETA to assemble the initial 1% sample package: 3 business days after sign-off (target: 2026-05-10).

Open items for Neha/Mina:
- Need guidance on minimum sampling size auditor expects (we can increase if required).
- Confirm whether auditor requires raw CloudTrail presigned URLs or consolidated CloudTrail extracts.

Let me know and I'll start exports.

-Rishi
Senior Infra Engineer, Redwood Inference

From: mina_haddad@redwood.com
To: neha.kapoor@redwood.com, rishi_malhotra@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Cc: sara@brightlinebank.com
Date: 2026-05-05T11:21:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Retention retrospective sampling RFI — Brightline SOC2

Thanks Rishi — technical approach looks good. A few security/evidence formatting clarifications to make the package audit-ready: 

Evidence formatting checklist (security):
- Manifest format: CSV with header exactly (pseudonym_tenant_id, object_hash_sha256, storage_path_redacted, last_modified_utc, deletion_job_id, deletion_timestamp_utc, region).
- Job logs: include K8s job annotation section (namespace, job_name, job_uid) and the orchestration runid. Provide runid->job mapping in a small index file.
- Chain-of-custody: include a signed attestation (PDF) on Redwoods' letterhead with signer (Mina) stating that artifacts are unchanged since export and describing redaction. Attach checksum file (checksums.sha256) listing sha256 of tars/manifests.
- CloudTrail: provide consolidated CloudTrail slice (JSONL) filtered to deletion_api calls for the sample tenant IDs, plus the S3 server-side delete markers if applicable. Do not include full account CloudTrail; only the filtered slice.

Sampling methodology note for auditors:
- We'll document stratified random sample generation (seed value in package), list seed and algorithm (e.g., Fisher-Yates shuffle seeded with 64-bit value). This lets auditors reproduce selection if they request.

Privacy/PII constraints:
- We will pseudonymize tenant IDs and hash object ids. Auditors have accepted hashed evidence in prior engagements; still, include a mapping disclosure (not the mapping itself) that explains the redaction process.

Delivery:
- I'll prepare the attestation PDF and checksums file. Rishi — please ensure manifests and job logs are included and checksums match. Marissa — coordinate external delivery mechanics (DocuSign for attestation? secure Drive link?).

-Mina
Security & Privacy Lead, Redwood Inference

From: neha.kapoor@redwood.com
To: sara@brightlinebank.com
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, rishi_malhotra@redwood.com, mina_haddad@redwood.com, audit-team@brightlinebank.com
Date: 2026-05-06T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Retention retrospective sampling RFI — Brightline SOC2

Hi Sara — thanks for the ask and for the clarity. We propose the following short plan: 

1) Sampling: stratified tenant-level sample (1% of tenants; min 2 tenants per region). Seed/algorithm documented in package.
2) Artifacts: for each sampled tenant we will provide manifest.csv (pseudonymized), deletion_job_log.txt, checksums.sha256 (SHA256 of manifests + tars), filtered CloudTrail JSONL slice, and a signed attestation PDF.
3) Redaction: tenant IDs pseudonymized; object ids hashed; no raw PII will be present.
4) Packaging/delivery: consolidated ZIP per tenant uploaded to our secure Drive folder. We will share a presigned, restricted link and provide checksums. No raw S3 console links.
5) ETA: initial package (1% sample) by COB 2026-05-10. If auditors request larger sample size we can scale — please confirm required sample fraction.

Attachments: retention_checklist.pdf (internal checklist we will use to assemble evidence).

If that works for the audit team, we'll proceed and I will notify once the Drive link is ready.

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Director, Compliance Programs
Redwood Inference
